title: Smoked Jamaican Tagine
description: A slow-cooked, flavorful stew originating from North Africa, infused with the bold flavors of Jamaica and the richness of smoked notes.

ingredients.name: Smoked neck of lamb
ingredients.notes: Look for smoked lamb neck at a specialty butcher or online

ingredients.name: Jamaican allspice
ingredients.notes: Ground allspice adds a warm, aromatic flavor

ingredients.name: Earthy tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or use store-bought

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Add natural sweetness to the dish

ingredients.name: Red wine
ingredients.notes: Choose a full-bodied red for depth

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the bottom of a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the lamb neck until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and carrots to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the smoked allspice, tagine spice blend, olives, red wine, tomato paste, and honey to the pot.
Return the lamb neck to the pot and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the lamb with two forks and serve over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
